t: The Perfect Pebble: A Minimalist's Guide to Igniting a Tech Movement
s: Pipulate advocates a local-first, minimalist tech stack (Nix, Python, HTMX) to counter modern web complexity, focusing on simplicity, reproducibility, and LLM compatibility for a contrarian movement.
sub: Local-first development with Nix, Python, and HTMX
HTMX for hypermedia-driven UIs without heavy JavaScript
Reimagining LAMP for modern minimalist development
